rulings.barItem: content that does not bear out the step's name
rulings.reason: Step 7 is named 'Use the refreshed public grant' but sends Bearer {pubtoken}, step 5's original access token, not {pubnew}, which step 6's refresh returned and no step ever uses. Step 13, 'Use the refreshed confidential grant', likewise sends {conftoken} from step 11 instead of step 12's {confnew}. X's page (https://docs.x.com/fundamentals/authentication/oauth-2-0/user-access-token) issues a new access token on the refresh_token grant, and that token is the one a refreshed grant is used with.
rulings.correction: Send Bearer {pubnew} in step 7 and Bearer {confnew} in step 13.

rulings.why: Send Bearer {pubnew} in step 7 and Bearer {confnew} in step 13.
